content.title: Integrations for Lattice
content.lead: Lattice works with the platforms, ingestion tools, orchestrators, catalogs and BI tools your team already relies on. Browse the integrations below, grouped by where they fit in your workflow.

cards.title: Northwind
cards.body: Build and run models on Northwind with native support for its SQL dialect.

cards.title: Quarry
cards.body: Transform data in Quarry with partitioned tables managed from your project.

cards.title: Helixa
cards.body: Run SQL and Python models on Helixa clusters, in step with notebooks.

cards.title: Stratus
cards.body: Model data in the Stratus lakehouse with its open table formats.

cards.title: Driftway
cards.body: Pair Driftway ingestion with models that run the moment data lands.

cards.title: Cobalt DB
cards.body: Use dynamic tables, warehouses and roles in Cobalt DB from your project.

cards.title: Pellucid
cards.body: Run models on the Pellucid query engine across files in object storage without moving them first.

cards.title: Ironbark
cards.body: Connect to Ironbark for low-latency analytical workloads and incremental model builds.

cards.title: Saltmarsh
cards.body: Build on Saltmarsh with support for its materialized views, schemas and access grants.

cards.title: Quillstack
cards.body: Sync data from hundreds of sources and trigger model runs as soon as each load finishes.

cards.title: Brightvane
cards.body: Stream change data from databases and transform it incrementally on arrival.

cards.title: Tideline
cards.body: Replicate files and application data into your warehouse on a schedule.

cards.title: Fernbrook
cards.body: Load event data from your product and keep raw tables documented as sources.

cards.title: Harbor Signal
cards.body: Trigger Lattice jobs from your pipelines and pass run results, artifacts and status codes to the next task in the chain.

cards.title: Wayfarer
cards.body: Schedule models alongside other workloads and see every run in one timeline.

cards.title: Cadence Flow
cards.body: Run Lattice jobs as steps in a larger workflow with retries and notifications.

cards.title: Lanternwork
cards.body: Orchestrate projects from code with typed assets that map to your models one to one, including tests and freshness checks.

cards.title: Ridgepole
cards.body: Kick off jobs from event triggers and wait for them to finish before moving on.

cards.title: Moorgate
cards.body: Coordinate batch and streaming jobs, with Lattice runs as first-class tasks.

cards.title: Sunstitch
cards.body: Use a visual pipeline builder that includes Lattice jobs as a native step type.

cards.title: Pinegrove
cards.body: Run Lattice commands inside containers on your own cluster with a ready-made operator that handles logs, retries and secrets for you.

cards.title: Ashfall
cards.body: Chain jobs across projects and teams with dependencies tracked automatically.

cards.title: Driftwood CI
cards.body: Run checks on every pull request and post results, changed models and test failures back to the review thread.

cards.title: Copperline Data
cards.body: Send modeled audiences and metrics back into sales, marketing and support tools.

cards.title: Relaybird
cards.body: Sync tested models to business applications on a schedule or as soon as a job completes, with field mapping kept in code.

cards.title: Watchtower
cards.body: Monitor freshness, volume and schema changes and link incidents to the models affected.

cards.title: Plumbline
cards.body: Add anomaly detection to key tables and route alerts to the owners named in your project.

cards.title: Sentinel Grid
cards.body: Profile columns, track distributions over time and catch drift before it reaches reports.

cards.title: Clearwater
cards.body: Combine test results with lineage to see the full impact of any data incident, from the source table to the dashboard.

cards.title: Benchmark
cards.body: Compare model outputs between environments before you merge a change.

cards.title: Steadfast
cards.body: Track data quality scores for every domain and share them with stakeholders.

cards.title: Lookout
cards.body: Watch pipeline health and costs in one dashboard, with alerts when a run takes longer or costs more than usual.

cards.title: Truecourse
cards.body: Validate business rules on modeled data and open tickets automatically when checks fail.

cards.title: Atlas Row
cards.body: Publish models, owners and descriptions to a company-wide catalog automatically after every deployment.

cards.title: Keystone
cards.body: Map lineage from sources through models to dashboards for impact analysis.

cards.title: Gatehouse
cards.body: Apply access policies and masking rules defined once across all your tools.

cards.title: Ledgerline
cards.body: Track sensitive columns and prove compliance with automated classification.

cards.title: Commonplace
cards.body: Give business users a glossary connected to the models that define each term.

cards.title: Wayfinder
cards.body: Search across models, metrics and dashboards from a single place with rich context from your project, including owners, tests and recent changes.

cards.title: Charter
cards.body: Review and approve changes to certified models with a governance workflow that records who signed off, what changed and which downstream reports are affected.

cards.title: Lensboard
cards.body: Build dashboards on certified metrics so every chart matches the source of truth, with lineage links from each tile back to the models and tests behind it.

cards.title: Sheetly
cards.body: Query shared metrics from spreadsheets with the same definitions as every report.

cards.title: Notewell
cards.body: Explore models in notebooks and promote useful queries back into the project.

cards.title: Chatline
cards.body: Let assistants answer questions with certified metrics and cite the models they used.
